segments.text: A gut peptide. Thirty amino acids. About two minutes in the blood before an enzyme erases it.
GLP-1. That brief signal is the molecular root of a major class of medicines for diabetes and weight.
Here, Protein Lab—an Omnigent agent on Databricks—sends the sequence to Boltz and returns a fold. Confidence, zero point eight three. P.L.D.D.T., zero point nine.
One session. Sequence to structure. Shared if you want it seen.
